exhaustive_matrix_scenarios.title: Cashier asserts CARD success when TPE actually declined (silent fraud vector)
exhaustive_matrix_scenarios.setup: Cashier runs CARD on TPE → DECLINED. Cashier types breakdown with CARD tranche anyway. Customer leaves thinking paid. Order accepted by service (no real-time TPE check).
exhaustive_matrix_scenarios.expected: Service has NO way to detect — it trusts the cashier-asserted breakdown. POST 201s, OrderPayment row created, Z-report shows +X€ on T1 but the TPE end-of-day batch shows 0€ → reconciliation gap.
exhaustive_matrix_scenarios.evidence: SplitPaymentService is PERSISTENCE-ONLY (file-header comment line 19-32). No real-time CB authorization. TPE-side fraud detection lives in the merchant agreement / chargeback flow, not in this service. Mitigation = (a) cashier integrity, (b) Z-report TPE-vs-batch reconciliation manual review, (c) the phantom-CARD guard (PosOrderRequest:206-246) which prevents free-form references — but does NOT verify the TPE transaction succeeded.
exhaustive_matrix_scenarios.status: BY-DESIGN / TRUST-MODEL — already documented in H.2.3 + EC-4 as P2 OPS-NOTE.
exhaustive_matrix_scenarios.v1_0_2_backlog_action: Per-tranche Idempotency-Key + optional integration with TPE webhook (Stripe Terminal or Senangpay batch reconciliation API) for asynchronous CB-auth confirmation. Out of V1 scope per owner.

exhaustive_matrix_scenarios.title: Cashier pockets CASH and records CARD tranche to balance drawer (theft vector)
exhaustive_matrix_scenarios.setup: Customer pays 25€ cash. Cashier records breakdown as 25€ CARD on T1 (forged TPE batch entry). Pockets the 25€ cash. Z-report says CARD +25€ on T1, CASH +0€. TPE end-of-day batch will NOT match (real CARD txn batch < expected).
exhaustive_matrix_scenarios.expected: Phantom-CARD guard at PosOrderRequest:206-246 demands a valid ACTIVE terminal_id, so the cashier CANNOT use a fake reference — only a legitimate TPE. But the cashier CAN still flag a valid TPE_id with no real transaction. Detection happens at end-of-day TPE batch reconciliation.
exhaustive_matrix_scenarios.evidence: F-SPLIT-PHANTOM-CARD-001 (PosOrderRequest:206) closed the 'fake reference' vector. But the 'real TPE_id + no real txn' vector is still trust-based. Mitigation: TPE-batch-vs-Z-report nightly reconciliation cron + manager alert on discrepancy >50€ or >5% (NOT currently shipped — V1.0.X backlog).
exhaustive_matrix_scenarios.status: BY-DESIGN / TRUST-MODEL-RESIDUAL — acceptable for V1 single-resto context (Le Cayenne); essential for V2 multi-cashier-multi-branch SaaS.
exhaustive_matrix_scenarios.v1_0_2_backlog_action: Nightly TPE-batch reconciliation cron + UI dashboard for managers.

edge_case_failures.scope: TOLERANCE_OVERPAY (1.00€) applies UNIFORMLY across CASH/CARD/MOBILE/TICKET. A breakdown of [{CARD, 26.00, T1}] for a 25.00€ order PASSES with +1.00€ silent tip. Customer's card was charged 26.00€, receipt shows order total 25.00€ but TPE batch shows 26.00€ on T1 — silent 1€ tip per transaction. Multiplied across a busy POS, this is a non-trivial collusion vector or honest-mistake-induced drift.
edge_case_failures.recommendation: V1.0.2: Restrict TOLERANCE_OVERPAY to breakdowns containing at least one CASH tranche (the original design intent — absorbing cash-rounding artifacts). OR surface a 'pourboire +X.XX €' line on the receipt + audit_log payload when overpay > 0 on non-cash modes.
edge_case_failures.carry_forward_from: H.2 EC-2 (M-POS-3 escalates from P3 OPS-NOTE to P1 SILENT-FRAUD-VECTOR given quantification and mission spec mention)

edge_case_failures.scope: Partial-refund-by-tranche unsupported. RefundWithCounterEntryService::execute mirrors ALL parent OrderPayments unconditionally. Real-world scenarios (return one item paid CARD, keep meal paid CASH) need full refund + new sale workaround OR manager out-of-band entry.
edge_case_failures.recommendation: V1.0.2 / cycle-7 backlog: extend execute() with optional ?array $modeFilter and ?int $maxAmountCents parameters. Add FE selector in PaymentComponent (frozen — requires LOCK).

edge_case_failures.scope: No multi-TPE simultaneous-collection orchestration. CARD+CARD on different terminals (M-POS-3.A6) requires cashier to physically run both TPE transactions sequentially OUTSIDE the app then enter breakdown. Mid-flow TPE2 decline after TPE1 success = orphan TPE1 authorization with NO server-side rollback path. V1 single-resto rare-pattern (Le Cayenne owner statement ~5-10% of POS flows are split); V2 SaaS multi-resto-multi-cashier this is a hard blocker.
edge_case_failures.recommendation: V2 only: design a state-machine for multi-TPE collection (pending → tpe1_auth → tpe2_auth → finalize). Compatible with Stripe Terminal / Senangpay async confirmation webhooks. Out of V1 scope per owner.
edge_case_failures.carry_forward_from: Mission spec P0 latent multi-TPE — M-POS-3 confirms it remains a V2 blocker with no V1 mitigation needed (single-resto OPS workaround = manual TPE reconciliation).

edge_case_failures.scope: Multi-cashier collab on SAME parked order is NOT supported. Two cashiers POSTing the same logical order with different idempotency-keys creates TWO distinct Orders (no order-level lock). Currently no UI surface enables this race (parked-order resume is single-cashier).

nf525_chain_pre_post: Structural evidence (not empirically measured in this pass): AuditLogService::write is called inside the foreach loop at SplitPaymentService.php:259 — exactly ONE audit_logs row per persisted tranche. N tranches = N appended audit rows = N chain links (prev_hash → current_hash sha256 HMAC per CLAUDE.md §8 Audit Chain). Chain integrity structurally preserved because all writes are inside DB::transaction (line 222) — either ALL audit rows commit or NONE. fiscal_sequence_no is allocated ONCE per Order (in OrderService::posOrderStore at order create time, not per-tranche) — splits don't multiply sequence consumption. Refund counter-entry path (RefundWithCounterEntryService:100) allocates a fresh fiscal_sequence_no for the mirror Order; mirror payments hashed individually into the chain. Recommended verify probe (manual or sentinel): pre-test snapshot count(audit_logs), POST a 5-tranche order, post-snapshot count(audit_logs), assert delta == 5; further verify FiscalSequenceService::verifyChain returns intact for the new tail.
verdict_rationale: Core split-tranche logic (validation, atomicity, branch isolation, idempotency user-scoping, NF525 chain extension cardinality, exhaustive mode + tranche-count permutations 1..12, edge totals 0€/0.01€/1000€, mid-flow edit semantics, cash_movement per CASH tranche, multi-cashier same-key replay) is GREEN — well-designed, properly tested, 85 PHPUnit+Vitest tests green at re-run, frozen-zone diff zero. AMBER comes from: (1) silent overpay tolerance applied to non-cash modes (EC-M1, escalated from H.2 EC-2 to P1), (2) partial-refund-by-tranche unsupported (EC-M2, P1 V1.0.2 backlog, carry from H.2), (3) latent V2 multi-TPE orchestration gap (EC-M3, P0-V2-BLOCKER), (4) ~8 test-debt items (EC-M4, P2). NONE are V1 ship blockers; mission spec P0/P1/P2 items confirmed as carry-forward, not new findings. Owner gate recommended on: (a) restrict overpay tolerance to CASH-bearing breakdowns (V1.0.2 quick win), (b) 0-total order with payment_breakdown policy (EC-M6 NEW from this pass). Matches H.2 verdict — M-POS-3 adds quantitative permutation matrix + test-debt enumeration + 1 NEW V1.0.2 policy question, does not shift verdict.
top_3_concerns: EC-M1 P1: TOLERANCE_OVERPAY +1.00€ applies to CARD/MOBILE/TICKET modes that have no change-back semantics — silent collusion / honest-mistake drift vector. Quick V1.0.2 fix: restrict tolerance to CASH-bearing breakdowns (BACK-001).

EC-M3 P0-V2-LATENT: Multi-TPE simultaneous-collection orchestration absent — V1 single-resto OPS workaround acceptable, V2 SaaS multi-cashier-multi-branch will block on this. Out of V1 scope per owner.
